x-changelog.summary: Sort by Created By company name and then by status and finally by issue number
x-changelog.description:
A new optional sort allows the index endpoint to sort by company name of the issue creator, then by status, and finally by issue number in descending order.

The status order will always be:

* `unblocked`
* `open`
* `ready_for_review`
* `blocked`
* `moved_to_observation`
* `closed`

To use the new sort, include the following query parameter: `?sort=company_then_status`
